title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
observed: After collecting a coin (state coins=1, score 100), the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5' at tick 1 and later.
expected: HUD always shows the current values, so after one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast
observed: With the pause menu open, btn-resume reports top=false (not the topmost element at its centre) while the 'Key collected' toast is visible, so a click on Resume would not reach it.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it.

title: Restart level leaves the game paused with no dialog
observed: After pause then click btn-restart, mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu is gone; the state no longer changes across subsequent waits (time stays 300, no dialog or button to act on).
expected: Restart puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away.

title: Spikes drive score negative and wrap it to 65136
observed: Spikes at score 100 produce score 65136 (wraparound from -400), and a later spike hit gives score -300.
expected: Spikes subtract 500 but the score stops at 0 and never goes negative or wraps; score stays within 0..999,999.

title: HUD coin counter stale after collecting a coin during a dash
observed: After dash-right at tick 1 the state reports coins=1 and Score 100, but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5'. The score field updated in the same tick, so only the coins readout lags.
expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows the current values, so after collecting a coin it should read 'Coins 1/5' to match state.coins.

title: Time-bonus banner covers the Finish button on the Level complete dialog
observed: At tick 41 the level-complete dialog is visible with btn-next (Finish) reported top=false, meaning the 'Time bonus +2590' banner sits on top of it at its centre, so a click on Finish would not reach the button.
expected: Section 7: every visible button must be clickable and nothing may cover it. Finish should receive clicks on the Level complete dialog.
